name: 3D Tilt Card
description: A card that lifts and tilts in 3D perspective on hover, with inner layers floating at different depths and a sheen sweep.
usage: Wrap the card in .scs-tilt (sets perspective). Inner content gets .scs-tilt__layer plus a depth class; tune the rotateX/rotateY and translateZ values to taste.

name: Animated Gradient Mesh
description: A living, slowly-shifting multi-color radial-gradient mesh background driven entirely by CSS keyframes.
usage: Wrap your section in a .scs-mesh element. The mesh fills the container; give the container a height (or use it full-screen) and place your content inside.

name: Aurora Background
description: Soft northern-lights glow blobs that slowly drift, scale, and fade behind your content.
usage: Wrap content in .scs-aurora and include the .scs-aurora__lights layer with its four spans. Give the wrapper a height; content sits above the aurora automatically.

name: Glassmorphism Card
description: A frosted glass card using backdrop-blur with a subtle light border and an inner top-left highlight.
usage: Copy the markup from index.html and styles.css. Place the card over a photo or gradient background so the backdrop-blur has something to frost.

name: Gooey Blob
description: An organic morphing gooey blob — a border-radius morph variant plus an SVG goo-filter variant that melts moving circles together.
usage: Option A: drop a .scs-blob div for a self-morphing blob (no SVG). Option B: paste the hidden SVG goo filter once, then use .scs-goo with child spans for circles that gooily merge.

name: Gradient Border Glow
description: An element wrapped in an animated rotating conic-gradient border with a soft blurred glow that brightens on hover.
usage: Add class .scs-gradient-border to any container and put content inside. Tune --scs-border-width and --scs-radius; recolor via the conic-gradient stops. Uses @property to animate the angle.

name: Grain / Noise Overlay
description: A fine film-grain texture overlay built from an inline SVG noise data-uri, addable to any section via one class.
usage: Add class .scs-grain to any positioned section. Optional modifiers: .scs-grain--film (heavier) and .scs-grain--animated (flicker).

name: Infinite Marquee
description: A smooth, seamless infinite horizontal marquee that loops without a jump and pauses on hover.
usage: Duplicate the content group twice inside the track (mark the copy aria-hidden). Tune speed/spacing with the --scs-marquee-duration and --scs-marquee-gap variables; add .scs-marquee--reverse to flip direction.

name: Neon Glow Button
description: A pill button with a layered neon glow (outer halo, ring, inner fill, text glow) that intensifies on hover and focus.
usage: Add class .scs-neon-btn to a <button> or <a>. Change glow color via the --scs-neon variable or the --sand / --violet modifier classes.

name: Shimmer Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder blocks with an animated shimmer sweep, plus shape and width helper classes.
usage: Use .scs-skeleton with a shape helper (--text, --title, --avatar, --thumb, --btn) and optional width helper (--w90/--w75/--w60/--w40). Compose blocks to mirror your real content, then swap in content when loaded.

name: Horizontal Scroll Gallery
description: Pins a track and translates it horizontally so vertical scrolling sweeps a row of panels sideways across the viewport.
usage: Wrap panels in .hscroll > .hscroll-track > .hscroll-panel and call initHorizontalGallery().

name: Image Scrub Sequence
description: Scrubbing the scroll plays through a frame sequence rendered to canvas (procedurally generated, no external image assets required).
usage: Provide a tall .scrub-section wrapping a pinned <canvas class="scrub-canvas">, then call initScrubSequence().

name: Magnetic Button
description: A button (and its label) is magnetically pulled toward the cursor while hovered and springs back on leave.
usage: Add class .magnetic with an inner .magnetic-label, then call initMagneticButtons().

name: Parallax Layers
description: Multiple depth layers translate at different speeds on scroll to create a sense of dimensional depth.
usage: Give layer elements data-parallax-speed (e.g. -0.3 to 0.6) inside a .parallax-scene and call initParallaxLayers().

name: Pinned Scroll Section
description: Pins a full-height section in place while its inner content animates through distinct stages as the user scrolls past it.
usage: Wrap your section in .pin-section with a .pin-inner and stage elements; call initPinnedSection() after GSAP + ScrollTrigger load.

name: Scroll Progress Bar
description: A slim fixed bar at the top of the page that fills from 0 to 100% as the user scrolls through the document.
usage:
Add a
at the top of body and call initScrollProgress().

name: Scroll Text Reveal
description: Lines or words rise up and fade in with a stagger as each block enters the viewport.
usage: Add data-reveal (optionally data-reveal="words") to text elements and call initScrollReveal().

name: Split Text Stagger
description: Splits a heading into characters or words in plain JS and staggers them into view (no paid SplitText plugin required).
usage: Add data-split ("chars" or "words") to a heading and call initSplitStagger(); fires on scroll into view.

name: Sticky Stacking Cards
description: A stack of cards where each pins in place and slightly scales back as the next card slides up and covers it on scroll.
usage: Wrap .stack-card items in a .stack-cards container and call initStackingCards().

name: Animated Counter
description: A number that eases up to a target value when it scrolls into view, with prefix/suffix and locale formatting.
usage: Use <AnimatedCounter value={1200} suffix='+' /> for a single stat, or <StatGrid /> for the sample row.

name: Bento Grid
description: A responsive asymmetric bento grid of feature cards with a subtle hover-lift and glow.
usage: Import BentoGrid and pass an items array, or use the default Sand & Surf sample content.

name: Command Palette
description: A ⌘K-style command palette modal with fuzzy filtering, keyboard navigation, and grouped commands.
usage: Render <CommandPalette commands={...} /> anywhere; press ⌘K / Ctrl+K to open. Pass your own commands array.

name: Dark Mode Toggle
description: An accessible animated theme toggle that morphs a sun into a moon and persists the choice to localStorage.
usage: Render <DarkModeToggle />; it toggles the `dark` class on <html> and remembers the preference.

name: Feature Accordion
description: A single-open accordion of features with smooth grid-based height animation and accessible disclosure semantics.
usage: Render <FeatureAccordion items={[...]} /> or use the built-in sample features.

name: Gradient Mesh Hero
description: A hero section with an animated gradient-mesh blob background, grain overlay, and a bold headline.
usage: Render <GradientMeshHero /> at the top of a page; pass eyebrow/title/subtitle/CTA props to customize.

name: Logo Marquee
description: An infinite horizontal marquee of client/partner logos with edge fade and pause-on-hover.
usage: Render <LogoMarquee logos={[...]} /> with text or node logos; defaults to sample wordmarks.

name: Pricing Toggle
description: Pricing cards with a monthly/annual switch that animates the displayed price and shows annual savings.
usage: Render <PricingToggle plans={...} /> or use the built-in sample tiers.

name: Shrinking Sticky Navbar
description: A sticky navbar that condenses its height and gains a backdrop blur once the page is scrolled.
usage: Render <ShrinkingStickyNavbar /> at the top of your layout; it manages its own scroll listener.

name: Testimonial Carousel
description: An auto-advancing testimonial slider with dot navigation, pause-on-hover, and smooth fade/slide transitions.
usage: Render <TestimonialCarousel testimonials={...} /> or use the built-in sample quotes.

name: Copy to Clipboard
description: A copy button that uses the async Clipboard API (with a legacy fallback) and shows an animated "Copied!" confirmation state.
usage: Add a button with data-copy="text" or data-copy-target="#selector". script.js handles copying and the confirmation state automatically.

name: Custom Cursor
description: A custom cursor with a precise dot and a lerp-trailing ring that grows and changes over links and buttons; hides the native cursor and disables itself on touch devices.
usage:
Link styles.css and script.js, add
to the page. Mark interactive elements with [data-cursor] or rely on a/button auto-detection.

name: Modal Dialog
description: An accessible modal dialog with focus trap, Esc-to-close, backdrop-click close, body scroll lock, and a fade/scale-in animation.
usage: Add the modal markup, give triggers data-modal-open="<id>". script.js wires open/close, focus trapping and scroll lock automatically.

name: Preloader
description: A polished full-screen preloader with an animated count-up and progress sweep that slides away once the page has finished loading.
usage: Paste the preloader markup as the first child of <body>, link styles.css and script.js. It removes itself on window load; reveals page content via a body class.

name: Scrollspy Nav
description: A navigation that highlights the current section using IntersectionObserver and smooth-scrolls to anchors on click.
usage: Give nav links href="#section-id" and a data-scrollspy attribute on the nav. Sections need matching ids. script.js observes them and toggles .is-active.

name: Smooth Scroll
description: Lerp-based smooth (inertia) page scrolling driven by requestAnimationFrame, with automatic opt-out for prefers-reduced-motion and touch devices.
usage:

...
. Disable by removing the script or via prefers-reduced-motion.

name: Tabs
description: Accessible tabs with full ARIA roles and arrow-key navigation, plus a sliding active indicator that animates between tabs.
usage: Use the tablist/tab/tabpanel markup with matching ids and aria-controls. script.js handles selection, keyboard nav and the moving indicator.

name: Theme Switcher
description: A light/dark theme toggle built on CSS variables and a data-theme attribute that persists to localStorage and respects the OS prefers-color-scheme.
usage: Add the inline no-flash snippet in <head>, a button with id="theme-toggle", then link styles.css and script.js. Build your UI with the provided CSS variables.
